prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: continuous source painting for a real reusable isometric dungeon border tile atlas, not a presentation mockup.
Reference image is approved style/material only. NEW ORIGINAL clean master artwork, one simple small square crypt room, no landmarks, no objects, no labels, no UI.

Draw a complete 2:1 isometric square enclosure with exactly FOUR corners. Full floor diamond oriented with far corner at top-center, left at mid-left, near at bottom-center, right at mid-right. Four straight wall runs with slopes exactly +1/2 or -1/2 in the image. Orthographic classic game isometric view. Camera must not turn the room into a front-facing trapezoid, octagon, hexagon or stage. Whole enclosure visible, generously padded on all sides.

The room consists of exactly THREE identical square modules along each side, a 3 by 3 logical floor grid: nine equal diamond floor areas. There must be NO explicit grid lines dividing modules: the stone paving texture continues naturally across them. Floor quiet simple regular small ashlar flagstones, not giant random boulders; each module has the same subtle broad value and material. Wall runs are long, low, evenly thick continuous masonry; exactly three equivalent repeated wall-length modules per run. Keep wall rise LOW: approximately one quarter of a single floor diamond's full screen width, to make the footprint and module endpoints easy to extract. Rear and foreground walls share exactly the SAME HEIGHT. Foreground wall not cut away. Same camera and pixel scale everywhere.

Every wall foot is beautifully merged into the pavement, via a continuous shallow coved dressed-stone base course, subtle contact shadow and matching mortar. Floor and wall are painted together as ONE structure. Corners are bonded L-shaped masonry with coping stones wrapping continuously; NO pillars covering corners, no free-standing corner posts, no gaps, no little isolated wall endings or endcaps. The wall stones and floor stones use even rhythmic courses so sliced modules can repeat without visible discontinuity. No unique cracks crossing many modules, no asymmetric lighting gradient, no shadow cast far across the floor. No bevelled floor corners, no thick floating slab/platform, no foundation block under floor.

Match approved restrained matte blue-grey limestone, soft subtle warm-grey floor wear, broad readable game-art forms, original high quality painted dark fantasy, fine restrained grout, restrained weathering, coherent soft light from upper left. No fog, fire, glossy water, moss blanket, vegetation, skull ornaments, decorations, arch, shrine, tombs, obelisks or characters. New art entirely; no old sprites.

Genuinely TRANSPARENT background with crisp antialiased silhouettes, no ground backdrop, no fake grey gradient around the room, no cast shadow outside room. High resolution near 2048 square. This master will be deterministically cut and normalized into actual reusable PNG tiles, so clean geometry and matched visual rhythm are essential.
status: Standalone exported tile-set work, not integrated with game
